newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine telephone firms meet 52 pct line target.
newsitem.headline: Philippine telephone firms meet 52 pct line target.

text.p: Philippine telephone firms have installed 2.72 million lines as of end-June, or 52 percent of the 5.23 million total lines they committed to install, the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) said on Thursday.
NTC documents showed that of the eight companies under the service area scheme, only ICC Telecoms has fully installed its total required lines under the scheme.

Cellular phone firms involved in the scheme are each required to install 400,000 lines while international gateway facility operators are supposed to put up 300,000 lines each in three years or by early next year at the latest.

Companies that are part of the service area plan include Globe Telecom, Isla Communications Co Inc, Major Telecommunications, Pilipino Telephone Co, Smart Communications Co Inc, Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc and Philippine Telegraph & Telephone Corp.
The NTC said Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, which is not part of the scheme, has installed 1.18 million lines as of the second quarter of the year.
